sentence: This project builds a platform that automates the analysis of kidney transmission electron microscopy images to help diagnose chronic kidney disease.
This project develops AI algorithms that analyze single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data to find problematic cells and the influences driving abnormal cell states.
This project studies how the hippocampus and prefrontal cortex guide decisions that rely on past experience or flexibly generating responses to familiar stimuli.
This project provides cell lines, gastric organoid cultures and xenograft models of nasopharyngeal and gastric carcinoma and tests compounds that target these cancers.
This project studies how central and peripheral stress response neurons affect the function of the cochlea during noise stress.
This project tries to find out which factors make heart cells divide, repair and regenerate the injured heart in mouse and pig.
This project tries to find out whether endogenous retroviruses are linked to alcohol use disorder through their expression or genotypes.
This project tests whether a natural compound from herbal medicine helps colorectal cancer cells present tumor antigens so immune checkpoint blockade therapy works better.
This project tries to find genetic factors linked to healthy aging and extreme longevity in humans.
This project uses two imaging methods on intact tissue to find changes in metabolites and proteins during Alzheimer's disease in vulnerable and resilient brain regions.
This project studies how azoles, common antifungal agents, cause developmental toxicity in early embryos, using single cell transcriptomic approaches and gene-editing tools.
This project inhibits the autophagy pathway in preclinical models of lung cancer to study metabolic changes in tumors and immune cells.
This project develops gene therapy approaches for Duchenne muscular dystrophy that are safer for patients.
This project studies how variant histone protein networks work in healthy cells and how diseases hijack them, focusing on what controls variant histone turnover.
This project studies the dynamics of the molecular interactions that let the virus behind Covid-19 enter host cells.
This project tests in a placebo-controlled trial whether an immune therapy helps patients with severe hidradenitis suppurativa, a chronic skin condition.
This project creates a measure of institutional barriers that includes economic indicators and is valid for English and Spanish speaking populations.
This project describes a shared resource that provides genomic sequencing and data analysis services to cancer researchers.
This project studies the circuits behind brain rhythms during sleep and their roles in learning and forgetting.
This project explores genetic modifiers of rare calcification disorders to understand the mechanisms of pathological calcification in cardiac valves and arterial walls.
